subject.title: [Bug]: Google Chat: Space/Group messages silently ignored (DMs work correctly)

question: Should this issue remain the canonical live-repro target for Google Chat @mentioned Space messages being accepted but skipped after the classifier fix, or should it be consolidated into broader Google Chat Space/thread routing work?
rationale: Source review can trace the skip path, but maintainer intent is needed before repair because the remaining failure depends on live Google Chat annotation shape and the safe boundary between mention detection, `botUser`, all-message ingestion, and thread-routing issues.

options.title: Keep Narrow Live-Repro Target
options.body: Keep this issue open for a redacted live Space webhook payload and then patch only Google Chat mention detection/session activation.

options.title: Consolidate Into Space Routing
options.body: Move the remaining work into the broader Google Chat Space/thread issue if maintainers want one combined Space-routing backlog item.

options.title: Treat As Config Workaround
options.body: Close only after maintainers confirm `requireMention:false` or a documented `botUser` setup path is the intended supported workaround.

recommendation.title: Keep Narrow Live-Repro Target
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open for a redacted live Space webhook payload and then patch only Google Chat mention detection/session activation.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent history across the Google Chat monitor/access path and the shared mention-policy refactor that would govern a safe fix.
